items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The name 'PAL' is mentioned by the interviewer as a recipient of benefits/charity work, but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond or provide any personal context linking him to this individual.

ctx.x: Well, PAL, different charities, Red Cross, oh goodness, just a lot of little different private little things we used to do. And that kept you quite busy. We were never off around the holidays, that seemed to be our busiest part. Busy season.
Well did Cab ever have a hit record?
